title: Huntress Cookbook Mobile
summary: Offline Flutter cookbook: browse chapters, read recipes with photos, search ingredients, edit locally, and view dietary guides—no network required after install.

blocks.content: Offline Flutter client for the Huntress Cookbook. Browse chapters, read recipes with photos, search ingredients, edit recipes locally, and view dietary guides — no network required after install.
blocks.heading: About

sidebarNote: Official APK is hosted on GitHub Pages.
releaseNotes:
All family members can add recipes
Only the person who added a recipe can edit or delete it
Bundled cookbook recipes stay MasterChef / Huntress editable
In-app update check is more reliable on real phones
Safer APK download with timeout and cleaner retry

features.title: Offline Cookbook
features.description: Browse chapters and recipes without a network connection.

features.title: Family Recipes
features.description: Add recipes locally; edit or delete only what you added.

features.description: Find ingredients quickly and view dietary guides in-app.
